subject: Renewal and capacity uplift — pricing concessions & price-hold
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@halcyonsystems.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:18:00-04:00
Subject: Renewal and capacity uplift: initial ask

Hi Tessa,

Quick summary from our side — Halcyon is approaching renewal for our production inference footprint on Redwood (current committed baseline: ~2M tokens/month). We have a new product launch targeting EU customers that will effectively double our production token consumption over the next 6–9 months.

Procurement asked me to surface options we can take to the August 25 review:
- 12-month renewal with an immediate uplift to 4M tokens/month (committed) OR a staged uplift starting Oct 1.
- We want a short-term price hold (60–90 days) at the proposed rate while procurement finalizes the contract.
- Interested in a one-time credit or bridge credit to soften the invoice for Q3 while usage ramps.
- EU roll-out: need clarity on pricing adders for cross-region and any private/VPC add-on.

I attached a small usage snapshot (usage_report_July.csv) so you can see our burst profile. Can you put together 2–3 compact pricing options (aggressive discount vs. committed uplift + smaller discount) and share any DocuSign/contract timelines? Procurement wants an executable path by Aug 25 if feasible.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if easier.

— Alex
Alex Rivera
Head of ML Engineering, Halcyon Systems
attachments: usage_report_July.csv
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@halcyonsystems.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T11:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal and capacity uplift: initial ask

Hi Alex —

On Thu, Aug 12, 2026 at 9:18 AM Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@halcyonsystems.com> wrote:
> Quick summary from our side — Halcyon is approaching renewal for our production inference footprint...

Thanks for the clear ask and the usage snapshot — very helpful. I can put together two concise options and loop Ben in to create a formal proposal and SOW. High-level before I draft:

- We can do a 12-month committed uplift to 4M tokens/month with a tiered discount structure.
- Price-hold for 60–90 days is doable; we'll propose 90 days by default and can shorten if procurement prefers.
- We typically offer one-time bridge credits (to be applied to the first invoice) or a staggered credit across the first 3 invoices; we can show both.
- EU roll-out: there's a region add-on for Private/VPC deployments; I'll ask Ben to include the exact pass-through cost.

Ben — adding you here to take the options into a proposal (HAL-2026-118). Alex, does Aug 18 at 10am ET work for a 30-min sync? If not, suggest two alternatives and we'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@halcyonsystems.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T15:25:00-04:00
Subject: HAL-2026-118 — Proposal (draft) + bridge options

Alex / Tessa —

Attached: HAL-RENEWAL-PROP-v3.pdf (pricing summary + SOW stub). Key points from the draft proposal:

1) Commit & term
- 12-month renewal, immediate uplift from 2M -> 4M tokens/month (committed).

2) Pricing & discount
- Committed rate: $0.00060 per token for committed volume (18% discount off list for committed buckets).
- On-demand overage: $0.00066 per token (1.1x committed rate).

3) Bridge/credits & price-hold
- One-time bridge credit: $50,000 applied to first invoice (or can be restructured as 3x monthly $16,666 credits on request).
- Price-hold: 90 days from proposal date; price will be honored while procurement finalizes execution.

4) Burst pool
- Complimentary burst pool: 200k tokens/month for first 3 months to absorb early ramp spikes.

5) EU expansion
- Private/VPC add-on: $12,000/month (to cover EU deployment footprint & dedicated routing). This is a pass-through operating add-on; will include a short statement of data residency controls.

6) True-up and billing
- Quarterly true-up based on actual consumption with an invoice adjustment. Overage charged at the on-demand rate above.

7) SLAs & protections
- Standard platform SLA included. We can add targeted SLO credits for latency/regional failover in the final SOW if required.

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm preference for one-time credit vs. monthly stagger; confirm payment term preference (Net 30 default).
- Procurement: Ben to share DocuSign link for signature-ready SOW when terms are agreed.

Deal ID: HAL-2026-118
attachments: HAL-RENEWAL-PROP-v3.pdf

Ben Carter
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:47:00-04:00
Subject: RE: HAL-2026-118 — Proposal (draft) + bridge options

Internal note (do not externalize) —

Ben / Tessa — reads clean from a commercial POV. A couple of internal asks before we finalize the SOW:

- Swap structure: prefer converting the $50k one-time credit into a $40k upfront invoice reduction + $10k uplift credit spread over the first two invoices. Procurement tends to sign faster with invoice reduction vs. credit accounting.
- SLA asks: add a short SLO credit clause for regional latency (>150ms 95th percentile) once we put EU into production; propose 5% service credit for sustained miss over a 30-day window.
- EU deployment: confirm whether the $12k/month add-on can be prorated for first 30 days of go-live (they'll appreciate the runway). If the add-on is non-prorated, consider offering first-month waiver.
- Risk note: request that legal flag any data residency verbiage to ensure we don't promise guarantees the Private plan can't meet.

I can greenlight once Ben updates the proposal and we have the small SLO language.

— Marissa
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
(Internal)
From: Priya Desai <p.desai@halcyonsystems.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@halcyonsystems.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T14:07:00-04:00
Subject: RE: HAL-2026-118 — Proposal (draft) + bridge options

Ben / Tessa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear options. Procurement reviewed the HAL-RENEWAL-PROP-v3.pdf and we are prepared to move forward with the following adjustments:

- We accept the 12-month renewal and uplift to 4M tokens/month.
- Please convert the bridge credit to an upfront invoice reduction as Marissa suggested (we prefer that from an accounting perspective).
- We ask for Net 60 payment terms (our standard); if you can’t move to Net 60, we can compromise on Net 45.
- For the EU Private add-on, please apply a first-month waiver rather than prorating.
- We appreciate the 90-day price-hold — please confirm that this includes the committed rate and burst pool.

I've attached the signed SOW (Signed_SOW.pdf) with countersigned initials on page 2. We also included a DocuSign envelope (link below) so Redwood can countersign and complete execution. Target to have fully executed by Aug 23.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/embeddedSigning?doc=HAL-2026-118
Signed SOW: Signed_SOW.pdf

If you can update the SOW to reflect the invoice reduction in place of the one-time credit, change payment terms to Net 60, and add a short SLO credit sentence for EU latency as proposed, we’ll countersign and close.

Thanks —
Priya Desai
Procurement Manager, Halcyon Systems
attachments: Signed_SOW.pdf
